name: Deliver to MacKinley
summary: Stoley hands you a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum for MacKinley, the "Sea Wolf" of Booty Bay, to put an end to MacKinley's beliefs about Booty Bay booze.

sections.title: A Bottle to Carry
sections.body: After the help you gave with the shipment, Stoley gives you a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum. You are to take it to MacKinley, in Booty Bay, so that he can finally let go of his crazy beliefs about the booze there.

sections.title: MacKinley's Verdict
sections.body: MacKinley tries the rum and cannot believe how awful it is, which delights him. Stoley kept his word about the bilge rum, so he need not pay the money he owes. MacKinley calls the stuff thick as gravel and burning like lava.

faq.q: Who receives the bottle of rum?
aliases: where do i take the bottle

faq.q: What kind of alcohol is being delivered?
faq.answer: A bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the chain?
aliases: what comes before deliver to mackinley
faq.answer: It follows Stoley's Debt and Stoley's Shipment.
